name: Switch
description:
An on/off toggle for a setting that applies right away: a native checkbox with role="switch".

  label(class: "flex items-center gap-2.5") do
    Switch(name: "airplane_mode", checked: true)
    plain "Airplane mode"
  end

It renders only the track and thumb - wrap it with its text in a <label>. `size:` scales both. Native attributes (name, value, required, form, aria_*) go to the <input>, `class:` to the track. `unchecked_value:` submits a value when it's off. Inside a Field it takes the field's id and state.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Switch(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  label(class: "flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm select-none") do
    Switch(size:, checked:, disabled:, **given(value:))
    plain "Airplane mode"
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` scales the track and thumb together.

examples.name: States
examples.notes: Off, on, disabled either way, and the error state (`aria_invalid:` or inside an invalid Field).

examples.name: With a label and description
examples.notes: A settings row: the whole card is one click target.
examples.code:
phlex do
  label(class: "border-border flex max-w-sm items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border p-5 select-none") do
    span(class: "flex flex-col") do
      span(class: "text-foreground-intense font-medium") { "Marketing emails" }
      span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm") { "Receive tips, product updates, and occasional offers." }
    end
    Switch(checked: true)
  end
end

examples.name: Reacting to changes
examples.notes:
It's a checkbox: listen for `change` (here a tiny Stimulus-free script updates the text).
`unchecked_value:` submits "0" when it's off.
examples.code:
phlex do
  label(class: "text-foreground flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm select-none") do
    Switch(name: "wifi", value: "1", unchecked_value: "0", checked: true, data: { demo: "wifi" })
    span { plain "Wi-Fi is "; span(data: { demo: "wifi-state" }) { "on" } }
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const wifi = document.querySelector("[data-demo=wifi]")
      wifi.addEventListener("change", () => document.querySelector("[data-demo=wifi-state]").textContent = wifi.checked ? "on" : "off")
    JS
  end
end
